name: Mental Health: Antidepressants in Major Depressive Disorder Corpus
description: Third research domain, added per docs/roadmap.md's 'Decision: the extraction and discovery framework must be domain-general, not per-field-patched'. Mirrors glp1_weight_loss's and oncology_nsclc_checkpoint_inhibitors's shape: one bounded population/intervention pair, not mental health in general.
scientific_domain: psychiatry -- SSRIs/SNRIs in adult major depressive disorder

research_question.text: Do selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) and serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs) reduce depressive symptom severity in adults with major depressive disorder (MDD)?

notes: 2026-08-08: corpus definition created, not yet seeded. No discovery cycles have been run and sources.csv is header-only. See docs/mental_health_corpus_scoping.md for the scoping rationale.
